# CekAPK

CekAPK is an Indonesian-language website for honest Android app information, free online tools, and APK safety checking before installing. CekAPK does not provide pirated, modded, gambling or adult apps; download buttons lead to Google Play or the official developer.

## How CekAPK verifies app safety

- Official source first: Google Play or the developer's own site
- Digital signature matched against the original developer
- Multi-engine security scanning; one malicious hit = not published
- App permissions explained in plain Indonesian
- Every app page displays its verification (checked-on) date
- Ratings are never fabricated

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://cekapk.com/
- App catalogue (50 apps): https://cekapk.com/aplikasi
- APK security hub: https://cekapk.com/keamanan
- Safety & how-to guides: https://cekapk.com/panduan
- Free tools: https://cekapk.com/tools
- Transparency report & methodology: https://cekapk.com/transparansi
- About & editorial policy: https://cekapk.com/tentang
- English edition: https://cekapk.com/en
